title: Orthonormality of characters
statement: Let $G$ be a finite additive commutative group, and let $\phi$ and $\chi$ be additive characters of $G$ with values in $\mathbb C$. Their inner product with respect to the uniform measure on $G$ is $1$ if $\phi=\chi$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $\phi$ and $\chi$ are additive characters of $G$ with values in $\mathbb C$
